WITH route3 AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('LINESTRING (-123.104083 46.164628, -123.104123 46.165938, -123.104199 46.167398)', 4326)::geometry AS geom
),
route4 AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('LINESTRING (-122.589431 45.416123, -122.589455 45.416843, -122.589474 45.416946, -122.589516 45.417068, -122.589516 45.417144, -122.589519 45.417494)', 4326)::geometry AS geom
),
dem_clip3 AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(ST_Clip(d.rast, ST_Envelope(r.geom))) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us d, route3 r
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, r.geom)
),
dem_clip4 AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(ST_Clip(d.rast, ST_Envelope(r.geom))) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us d, route4 r
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, r.geom)
),
segments AS (
  SELECT 1 AS route_id, (ST_DumpSegments(r.geom)).geom AS seg FROM route3 r
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 2 AS route_id, (ST_DumpSegments(r.geom)).geom AS seg FROM route4 r
),
endpoints AS (
  SELECT
    route_id,
    ST_StartPoint(seg)         AS p1,
    ST_EndPoint(seg)           AS p2,
    ST_Length(seg::geography)  AS seg_len_m
  FROM segments
),
elev AS (
  SELECT
    e.route_id,
    e.seg_len_m,
    CASE WHEN e.route_id = 1 THEN ST_Value(dc3.rast, 1, e.p1)
         ELSE ST_Value(dc4.rast, 1, e.p1) END AS z1,
    CASE WHEN e.route_id = 1 THEN ST_Value(dc3.rast, 1, e.p2)
         ELSE ST_Value(dc4.rast, 1, e.p2) END AS z2
  FROM endpoints e, dem_clip3 dc3, dem_clip4 dc4
),
grades AS (
  SELECT
    route_id,
    seg_len_m,
    CASE WHEN seg_len_m > 0 THEN ABS(z2 - z1) / seg_len_m END AS grade
  FROM elev
  WHERE z1 IS NOT NULL AND z2 IS NOT NULL
),
avg_grade AS (
  SELECT
    route_id,
    SUM(grade * seg_len_m) / NULLIF(SUM(seg_len_m), 0) AS g
  FROM grades
  WHERE grade IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY route_id
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN a1.g >= a2.g THEN 'Mayger Fill Road' ELSE 'Southeast Anna Marie Court' END AS answer_name,
  DEGREES(ATAN(a1.g)) AS slope_deg_3,
  DEGREES(ATAN(a2.g)) AS slope_deg_4
FROM avg_grade a1
JOIN avg_grade a2
  ON a1.route_id = 1 AND a2.route_id = 2
WHERE a1.g IS NOT NULL AND a2.g IS NOT NULL;

WITH road_geoms AS (
  SELECT 
    '[3]' AS id,
    ST_GeomFromText('LINESTRING (-123.104083 46.164628, -123.104123 46.165938, -123.104199 46.167398)', 4326)::geometry AS geom
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    '[4]' AS id,
    ST_GeomFromText('LINESTRING (-122.589431 45.416123, -122.589455 45.416843, -122.589474 45.416946, -122.589516 45.417068, -122.589516 45.417144, -122.589519 45.417494)', 4326)::geometry AS geom
),
slope_analysis AS (
  SELECT
    r.id,
    ST_Avg(ST_Slope(ST_Clip(rast, true, geom), 1)) AS avg_slope
  FROM
    road_geoms r
    CROSS JOIN public.dem_us d
  WHERE
    ST_Intersects(d.rast, r.geom)
  GROUP BY
    r.id, r.geom
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN s1.avg_slope > s2.avg_slope THEN '[3]'
    WHEN s1.avg_slope < s2.avg_slope THEN '[4]'
    ELSE 'Equal'
  END AS higher_slope_road,
  s1.avg_slope AS slope_road_3,
  s2.avg_slope AS slope_road_4
FROM
  slope_analysis s1
  JOIN slope_analysis s2 ON s1.id = '[3]' AND s2.id = '[4]';
